method: Downloaded both Mechanical Engineering papers for each exam and year from the official UPSC current and archived listings; verified PDF signatures and hashes.
Reviewed OCR across all 40 papers, visually checked the selected English questions and all 128 complete native-PDF crops.
Grouped linked subparts when the official marks apply to the group; included diagrams, page continuations, supplied charts and relevant property tables.

Included solar collectors, thermal storage, condenser/cooling-tower transfer, thermal loads and direct welding/laser heat-transfer applications. Pure cycles and unrelated manufacturing, mechanics or fluid-flow questions remain outside this subject.
All questions have independently derived model references, stated assumptions and a question-specific self-review checklist. These are not official UPSC answer keys.
limitations: Some official questions omit properties, specify inconsistent values or print ambiguous correlations. Their references state conditional results and distinguish the literal question from any proposed correction.
Conventional Mains working requires student or teacher self-assessment; no automatic correctness or official marks are claimed.

duplicateReview.policy: Existing IDs and confirmed objective duplicates are unchanged. Similar concepts across different exam tracks or different required derivations are retained.
